scope: Bounded native Pi canaries on exact branch wheels. This index does not assert broad scientific or release acceptance.
availability: Receipts are local operator records at the listed paths, not committed public reproducibility artifacts or physical measurements. Hashes identify those local records; readers without them cannot independently reproduce this audit from the index alone.
limits: No sealed outcomes, physical experiments or new predictive calibration were used.
One trajectory per wheel is not causal evidence of improved CLI behavior, instruction effectiveness, learning or stopping. Wheel, instruction, admission and scoring differences confound comparisons.
Raw agent reports contain unsupported scientific statements; they remain unchanged and are labeled QUALIFIED.
Closed CLI-only harness excludes unrelated fatigue corpus and replay service. Their observation/release smokes are inapplicable, not passed.
Configured native Pi calls use a capped relay; the cap is not an adversarial key-level boundary because another existing relay remained reachable on the internal network.

budget.accounting_rule: Reserve 132000000 nanodollars per call before forwarding. Settle only complete authenticated upstream HTTP200 SSE final usage.cost, rounded up to nanodollars. Missing, malformed, truncated and failed calls retain full reservation. Prior PR2 calls are never settled from client-reported usage.
